items.title: Tom Lellis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 31, 2007
items.q: Well you know everybody loves Charlie Parker you know. And I love Charlie too

ctx.x: What was it that grabbed you about him? © Fillius Jazz Archive -16-
Well you know everybody loves Charlie Parker you know. And I love Charlie too, but I think Cannonball did more with less. He swung harder with less. Do you feel that way?
I think, plus his tone was, I mean as a saxophone player it’s like well there you go.
